maya_customer: Hi — our prod traffic hit a bunch of 500s around 10:07am PST, can you tell us what to gather so you can repro?
alex_support: sorry about that — we can usually triage fast if you send a few items. quick list below, then paste any logs you have.
maya_customer: ok thanks, what exactly do you need?
alex_support: minimal repro packet: 1) the x-redwood-request or x-request-id from the client (or server) headers for at least one failing call. 2) full request body (no API keys) and the response body/headers you saw. 3) HAR from the browser or curl output for the failing request. 4) approximate timestamps and region (e.g. 2026-03-15 10:07:23–10:09:00 PST, us-west-2). 5) model/route and SDK version if using our SDKs.
maya_customer: where is the request id in our dashboard?
alex_support: in the Console: Console -> Requests -> filter by time -> you can paste the request id into the search. clicking a row opens the Request details with headers, body, and the backend trace link. if you don't want to use Console, the SDKs and responses also include the header: `x-redwood-request-id` (or `x-request-id`).
maya_customer: we only have a mobile repro, not a desktop HAR.
alex_support: for mobile (iOS/Android) please do: 1) capture the SDK logs around the time of the error (increase logging if needed), look for lines like `INFO request sent id=abc123 status=500` or `req_id=abc123`. 2) If you can reproduce, run a proxy (Charles/Fiddler) to capture a HAR-equivalent and export as HAR with content. 3) If you can’t proxy, paste the raw request JSON and the SDK log snippet with the request id.
maya_customer: example of a curl we can send?
alex_support: yeah — curl that reproduces the request (redact API key):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.local/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: my-local-test-123" \
  --data '{"model":"gpt-3x","input":"hello"}'
```
Include the full `-i` output so we see response headers. if you see a `x-redwood-request-id` in the response, include that value too.

sam_platform: small note — if the error looks rate-limitish, include the 429/Retry-After header, and whether requests were routed through Dedicated or Hosted.

nora_sre: also helpful: a short timeline of attempts (count, concurrency), any autoscaling events on your side, and whether you saw timeouts vs immediate 500s.

maya_customer: sending logs now, attaching a small HAR and a curl capture.

maya_customer: HAR: https://file-share.company/har/abc-har-20260315.har (contains the failing POST and response)

maya_customer: logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-15T10:07:21Z app: request start id=abc123 route=/v1/generate
2026-03-15T10:07:22Z sdk: got response status=500 req_id=abc123 body="Internal server error"
```

alex_support: received — thanks. we'll correlate req_id=abc123 across our traces. if we need a time-window we’ll ask, but this is usually enough to pull the server-side trace and the backend logs.

alex_support: one final ask: if possible, include the exact request JSON (not prettified) and the response body; if there are attachments or base64 blobs, note sizes. we never need API keys — redact them.

devbot: Incident saved: INC-20260315-22; linked req_id=abc123 for SRE review.

nora_sre: picking this up, will post updates in this thread after trace correlation. :mag:
